card_title: Remediate Strategy B v2 selector composite-axis bug
summary: Production-discovered script bug in the B v2 runner: axis_values() registers 6 joint-space axes (ema_pair and walk_forward are COMPOSITE tuple axes) but tie_break_key()/cohort_neighbourhood() indexed those composite axes with scalar members of the 8-scalar cell_key. u2 crashed with ValueError: 10 is not in list while selecting the BTCUSDT/15m cohort winner. Minimal fix: a registered-axis key helper (axis_key) plus a registered-index lookup that fails closed, and a neighbourhood that moves exactly one REGISTERED VALUE per axis. No hypothesis/domain/split/gate/DCA-semantics change; u1/u2 stay immutable FAILED technical attempts; no u3 launch; reconciler stays paused.

production_root_cause.traceback: 30_strategy_b_run.py line 1072 run_cohort -> line 1166 select_cohort_winner -> line 1137 tie_break_key -> axes['ema_pair'].index(cell_key(r)[0])
production_root_cause.log_tail: BTCUSDT/5m completed all 10 registered grids (5,760 rows each, winner=None / no qualifying candidate); BTCUSDT/15m historical grid wrote 5,760 rows and the selector crashed on the first qualifying candidate (ema_fast=10)
production_root_cause.latent_twin: cohort_neighbourhood() used wkey[ai] against the same composite axes (same misalignment; would have crashed right after the selector was fixed)
production_root_cause.why_5m_did_not_crash: select_cohort_winner() returns before the tie-break sort when no candidate qualifies; the 5m historical grid has 0 qualifying cells, so the bug only surfaced on the first cohort with >=1 qualifying candidate

fix.cell_key_unchanged: cell_key(r) keeps the 8-scalar exact-cell identity; cross-grid lookups, same_cell and the neighbourhood index still key on it
new_helpers: axis_key(r) -> 6-axis registered key ((ema_fast, ema_slow), (wf_train_days, wf_test_days), spacing_pct, size_multiplier, breakeven_tp_pct, invalidation_pct)
axis_index(axes, axis, value, row) -> registered index, fail closed naming axis/value/cell
fix.tie_break_key: uses axis_key(r) and axis_index() against axis_values(spec); registered-index lexical order unchanged (contract 7.3)
fix.cohort_neighbourhood: +/-1 REGISTERED INDEX on exactly one of the 6 registered axes; composite axes move one whole registered tuple; mutated registered-axis key is converted back to the 8-scalar cell key before the grid lookup; missing legal neighbour fails closed and now names the axis/step/cell
fix.no_scope_creep: no new abstraction/service/registry; selector/disposition versions unchanged (cohort-selector-v1 / cohort-disposition-v1)

open_findings.severity: non-blocking (out of this card's minimal-fix scope, flagged for the u3 run-spec review)
open_findings.finding: the 8-scalar CSV row carries ema_fast/ema_slow/wf_train_days/wf_test_days but NOT keys named 'ema_pair'/'walk_forward', so _pick() silently drops both composite axes from the emitted cohort winner record (result.json / artifacts/cohort_results.json / artifacts/cohort_survivors.json). Strategy A's row does carry its axis-named fields (window/discount), so A is unaffected and B is asymmetric.
open_findings.impact: downstream survivor index/evidence consumers that read the winner's strategy params (runtime/survivor_index.py STRATEGY_PARAM_KEYS) would find no value for the B param axes; B has no survivor yet, so nothing is broken today.
open_findings.not_remediated_because: fixing it changes the emitted record shape (and ROW_FIELDS is a frozen CSV surface compared by the evidence package), which is outside this card's minimal fix (items 1-4) and its 'no semantic change / minimal diff' boundary
open_findings.evidence: record() at 30_strategy_b_run.py:923-949 emits ema_fast/ema_slow/wf_train_days/wf_test_days; _pick() filters missing keys; runtime/survivor_index.py:66 STRATEGY_PARAM_KEYS = ('window','discount')
